### 2026-10-11 – Finished up the PCB and started on firmware!

**3.75h**

Finished up the PCB and started on firmware!

![Screenshot 2026-10-11 at 4.01.32 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/e302541e2475fff046ebdc3e613baa183807192c583c55ed9349cf73c35eb761.png)
Started this session off by changing the footprint of the XIAO to match to the C3 just in case so it wouldn’t cause any problems in the future. Managed to find a library and downloaded it (it worked yay!) However, I immediately ran into a few problems. Suddenly some parts of my PCB were unrouted..? Even though it looked like the lines were literally on the pad. I ended up taking more than an hour to fix this 😞 I was trying out different ways and in the end it had to do with the lines being F.cu/B.cu so once I changed them around, everything was properly routed! 😌

![Screenshot 2026-10-11 at 5.18.23 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/6719d4faeac924040a7ea91ae92e02089ce67fd403358faa5c757987c0b26451.png)
Learnt how to do a ground plane! Watched YouTube and got it after a while :) Ended up changing my edge cuts border a lil to align everything w the fill too

![Screenshot 2026-10-11 at 5.47.50 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/f95a5a415f0063c6e94bc7bda50cbd60c8c544fe5ae0e7769751a6ecf2afb573.png)
After making sure everything on the PCB was ready, I moved onto adding images on the PCB yayyy 😁 I was a little confused at first but all I had to change was to make it a footprint to F.cu silkscreen (which I did not do at first ahem 😬) Had fun designing this part! Added a cute lil star (represents starbie!) and the half life logo as well as ‘starbie 2026’ for record! Had to tweak and try different sizes until I was satisfied. Loved how it turned out :)

![Screenshot 2026-10-11 at 6.52.12 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/9e8d70c1289a2170192500c21fe1af82092a823e388a09818783fda30e498767.png)
Finally, moving on to the software of Starbie!! Well I’m not too sure how this’ll go since I don’t have any coding experience but I shall figure it out along the way :) Downloaded the Arduino IDE and installed everything required by the guide. Ran into a teeny problem while following it as I didn’t know what they meant by installing the Starbie.ino  but google was there to help, fortunately

### 2026-10-11 – Finishing off Week 1 for Starbie!

**4.5h**

Finishing off Week 1 for Starbie!

![Screenshot 2026-10-11 at 9.07.19 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/d63c4589a392c46f6452b3b095e63e3cd650f8b568cc0958d231bfad78f72915.png)
Getting into the firmware, I had absolutely no idea what was going on... Tried to read the code and understand the logic as much as possible (haha...) Decided I'd make my sprite first since it was something I could manage!

![Screenshot 2026-10-12 at 2.17.01 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/c86f63baf3ad4edeb1d75529f43cf10e14325b432801293781ebc13afdde0750.png)
Made my sprite! I settled on just eyes and a mouth since the OLED display is going to be quite small. Converted it using the image2cpp and got the byte array. Hooray!

![Screenshot 2026-10-11 at 11.06.21 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/8e00ea6658da52584833e534f714f4eb6626f6ad958eec6ecbe5d9d4b6b2d20c.png)
After which, I followed the guide on what to add. (I was kinda doing the guide here backwards, don't mind me heh...) Was a tad bit confused but that's alright, because I tried!

![Screenshot 2026-10-12 at 2.16.17 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/64c4cb4b36deeb1d0aef4bbb23f619b9f61d04d1f63c64700e2abb2145baa760.png)
Finally started on collating my BOM and putting it into Half Life (which took a considerable amount of time...) and then put it into a .csv file to add it into my repo! Staying in the Tier 1 fund of $30 was quite difficult but luckily I have a few items on hand already :)

![Screenshot 2026-10-12 at 2.16.04 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/f72e7f9eeb34445f877a454733959a8666e1589500ffe39d2ce33dcc7a3b464f.png)
It was the last stretch! Finalising everything and adding everything into my repo on GitHub! This one took quite a while since I didn't know how to export anything or how to even make a file in GitHub... but google and youtube were my best friends here and I got the hang of making files HAHA
Managed to export the KiCad files, Arduino IDE, and Gerber files (very interesting!) and tidied everything up in the repo. Also updated the README.md (heavily referenced from the guide) :D

This week has definitely been an eventful first week. I've learnt so so many things. Being exposed to hardware for the first time: now I know how to use KiCad (WOAH) and using the Arduino IDE firmware (still getting there though). Plus, it's always nice to see everyone else's amazing and creative ideas!
I'll be updating Starbie along the way since it's far from perfect, but I'm happy with how far I've come YAY

### 2026-10-25 – Finishing touches for PCB design!

**4.7h**

Finishing touches for PCB design!

![Screenshot 2026-10-26 at 6.12.23 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/e6291c377a9719926cd0c07c70a63b6d9adf1852db00da4a4b71db321f236fbe.png)
After laying everything out nicely, I started with the edge cuts border! For this project, I attempted making rounded edges (since I had only done a straight-lined border before for Starbie) and well it definitely tested my patience. When I first made the curve, I didn't quite understand how it worked and also it was really difficult to get a nice radius to make the curve curve nicely >:) and to also connect with the straight lines!! It took so so long to get everything aligned but it was definitely worth it. Well, I picked up a little trick (if you can even call it that haha) when I was doing the rounded edges. It was just to make the curve angled at 90' so that it would line up with my lines ^-^ I felt so accomplished every time it lined up nicely~

![Screenshot 2026-10-26 at 6.18.11 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/d693c3ee84985624be4d536fb414656b63039f2af676993f8127d33b50d5f965.png)
The finished edge cuts border! I'm pretty sure none of them have the same radius/curve but we don't talk about that! I'm just glad it looks nice and the hard work paid off :D

![Screenshot 2026-10-26 at 6.37.53 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/422232ce4ac766d3cbc9c5b66119807301257a6f6f92333781ac67c233270476.png)
Just like that, it was time to route the PCB! It may not be the neatest looking but I tried! When it was time for the DRC, I was in pure delight! Only 1 warning oh em gee! Well before that I did miss a route but I fixed that real quick (tysm drc!) and wow compared to Starbie which had like idk 20+ warnings because of the silkscreen, this was heaven. woohoo!!

![Screenshot 2026-10-26 at 6.58.58 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/c85fcc3240a4655a0ba09a0c07308a9b307bb97bc88bd1108ae2f05411c157a7.png)
Now, it's time for the fun part!! I love love putting images on the PCB, they really bring it to life! I added the Half-Life logo, some music notes, and a cute blob dude and cow listening and jamming to music :D I thoroughly enjoyed this part as I looked for relevant pictures to put on hehe
One part that stood out when doing this was when I was converting the cute lil cow. Since the original picture wasn't super high on contrast and had different shaded parts, it was a little bit difficult to distinguish them and decide the black/white threshold. Luckily, it didn't turn out too bad!

![Screenshot 2026-10-26 at 7.06.47 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/a2c069c420eade50eb47cd6123839ff995277c01ca6314ea3af3ee70024d76bf.png)
Time to import the 3D modelsssss! I actually missed out on this for Starbie's because I kinda didn't even realise what it was for or how to import them but I learnt how to do it this time from the guide (thank you)! Although some of them came through a lil wonky like the one above, some fixes to the rotation and axes worked like a charm :)

![Screenshot 2026-10-26 at 7.11.09 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/5P3Dphgp8XJhnIuD5gc00fblVm4s8Lon/36b603e0678347c5d7c142dd1791cb1e17f005802a87d84c882495cf7fc41c17.png)
Soon enough, I had imported all of the 3D models and it looked really great in the 3d viewer :DDD
For this part though, I was reminded of how important it is to look at things from a different view every once in a while, because I found out that the spacing between my switches were really off!! I also decided to move my blob and cow a lil closer so that the whole thing would look more coherent. Glad I managed to fix these after looking at it from afar :))

And that was it for the MIDI Keyboard design!

After that though, I learnt how to install a plugin for the fabrication toolkit :O I was a little bit confused on where to install it and import it in, because I thought once I downloaded it KiCad would magically know it was there HAHA but of course, I had to go to the main page and install it. Glad that wasn't too difficult!
